text: As I stand in this thoughtfully designed space, I feel a curious sense of anticipation. The glass walls invite reflection—both literal and metaphorical—while the hurried figure passing by contrasts with my own stillness. Here, I’m surrounded by the artifacts and ideas of research and development, which makes me ponder on the relentless human drive to innovate and understand. It’s as if I’m in a threshold between action and contemplation, where the world’s potential is waiting to be revealed by those who pause long enough to notice.
